title: Page 138
transc:
Hd Qrs Genl Butler May 21 . 1864 
3.45 P. M.
major I have had private Huyck Camp pebble
amos detailed as operator for outer line Rodneys
zebra Snow is at Bermuda landing Nichols at
maxims Collings at Nankins & Homan have zodiac
all have to do considerable night duty &
all work cheerfully & well we have incessant
negro practice & considerable musketry ravishing without any
apparent result except that we must keep considerable
walpole force employed zodiac all is apparently healthy
unity line to Jamestown impracticable at present unity
benders message yesterday came from growl in plank
hours mansion minutes zebra if you have few
miles signal field cord to spare it might
be useful here in hurried operations this is
a very woody country awful road just now 
R OBrien


Hd Qrs Gen'l Butler May 21 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
from silver field the in may harsh
plug mary fun honorable Henry Wilson chairman
military committee grapes zebra please send me
what is the precise state of maxims
names before the senate of not incon
sistent with the public service unity have
you received a letter from me dated
may plunder please answer by wrangle walrus
Knox please have answer sent in penfield
R OBrien
